about: What the wild build's music and voices were asked for (tools/sound/music.mjs, voice.mjs). Models make something a little different each time they are asked: this is a record of the asking, not a recipe that gives the same files again.

music.preamble: Instrumental only: no vocals, no choir, no spoken words. About 75 seconds. Underscore for a stealth action video game set in a hidden uranium enrichment site cut deep into a mountain and guarded by machines. Dark, cinematic, industrial, in D minor. Steady from the first bar to the last — no intro that builds up, no breakdown, no silence, no fade-out — so that it can loop.

title.prompt: Slow and vast: low brass and cellos holding long notes, a lonely horn motif that keeps returning, a deep pulse like a heartbeat at 60 bpm, cold air around it, one deep drum hit every eight bars. Dread and scale: a mountain at night with something awake inside it.

infil.scene: unseen, outside the halls: the adit, the cavern, the corridors
infil.prompt: Almost nothing: a very quiet sub drone, a few sparse high metallic pings with a long cavern echo, a slow soft pulse at 70 bpm far away, pads like held breath. Intensity 2 out of 10 throughout. Someone hiding in the dark.

hall.scene: unseen, in the cascade hall among the centrifuges
hall.prompt: Eerie and mechanical: a high shimmering whir like hundreds of spinning rotors turned into glassy harmonics, a slow pulsing low synth under it, ticking machinery in six-eight time, cold and exact. Intensity 3 out of 10 throughout.

tense.scene: a machine is wary or searching
tense.prompt: Tension: a steady tactical groove at 95 bpm — a muted kick, ticking hats, a pulsing bass ostinato, short string stabs, a riser now and then. Intensity 5 to 6 out of 10 throughout. They are looking for you.

combat.prompt: Full combat: 150 bpm, pounding distorted kick drums and metallic anvil hits on every beat, a snarling distorted bass riff, aggressive staccato strings and brass stabs, synth screams like sirens. Loud and relentless: intensity 9 out of 10 from the very first second to the last.

overspeed.scene: the drives pushed past their limit
overspeed.prompt: Out of control: 170 bpm, frantic sixteenth-note arpeggios climbing higher and higher, a shrieking rising lead like a siren, heavy pounding drums, everything accelerating towards a breaking point. Intensity 10 out of 10 throughout.

exfil.scene: the run out before the strike lands
exfil.prompt: A race against a countdown: 160 bpm, driving ostinato strings, big cinematic drums, the tick of a clock on every beat, brass that is heroic and desperate at once, constant forward motion. Intensity 9 out of 10 throughout.

end.prompt: Aftermath: slow, wide, quiet relief with sorrow in it — warm low strings, a simple piano figure, a distant rumble dying away. 60 bpm. Intensity 2 out of 10 throughout.

warden.what: the site's own mind: every line of src/wild/warden.js
warden.manner: none asked for by default: this speech model reads a manner out as often as it takes it; the colour makes it WARDEN

pa.what: the site's public address, a recording: the lines of src/wild/voice.js

sfx.about: What tools/sound/sfx.mjs asked a video-generating model for (the Interactions API, 18 November 2026): the owner wanted firing, explosion, enemy-fire and centrifuge sounds that are RECOGNISABLE — every sound in the game before tonight was synthesised and a listening model found most of them unrecognisable. Each prompt asks for sound only, 3-4 seconds, a single instance of the thing (one round, one blast) so the onset-cut gives a clean take; 'cut' is the target length after the onset is found; 'gate' is the family of blind labels (tools/sound/listen.mjs LABELS) that count as right; 'tilt' marks the sounds that need the low end raised into what a small speaker can play (docs/WILD-sfx.md, the gate). This is a record of the asking, not a recipe that gives the same files again.

shotSentry.prompt: Sound effect only: no speech, no voice, no music. A heavy military rifle fires a single unsuppressed round, heard from twelve metres away inside a concrete cavern: a sharp crack, a hard boom, and a short rolling echo off rock walls. One shot only, no burst. About one second.
shotSentry.describe: a sentry robot's heavy rifle firing one unsuppressed round at the listener, from ten to fifteen metres, in a concrete cavern

old.heard: A single loud gunshot is fired.
old.label: gunshot, unsuppressed
fixes: Replace pitched oscillator with broad-spectrum noise decaying over 150ms
Add reverb with 2000ms decay and strong early reflections
Add a transient sine layer dropping from 150Hz to 50Hz over 50ms

shotDrone.prompt: Sound effect only: no speech, no voice, no music, no motor, no machine noise. A single small-calibre gunshot heard from ten metres away inside a concrete cavern: one short, dry, high-pitched crack, lighter and thinner than a rifle, with a brief hard echo off the walls. One shot only, no burst. About half a second.
shotDrone.describe: a drone's lighter, faster gun firing one round at the listener in a concrete cavern

chosen.note: Two batches of three, the second with this prompt (the first named a drone, and got motors). Heard blind as a bleep (three times), a motor and gun handling; one generation was refused by the model's own filter. Never as a gunshot: the game's own stays.

explosion.prompt: Sound effect only: no speech, no voice, no music. A single large explosion inside a concrete cavern: a sharp crack, a heavy boom, debris and a long rolling echo. About four seconds.
explosion.describe: a single large explosion inside a concrete cavern

old.heard: A rapid series of irregular clicks resembling a Geiger counter detecting radiation.
old.label: other
fixes: Add a dense reverb with a 3 to 5 second decay time
Layer a sine wave sweeping from 80 Hz down to 30 Hz
Extend the noise envelope decay to at least 2000 milliseconds

cascadeBlast.prompt: Sound effect only: no speech, no voice, no music. A huge demolition blast inside a vast underground industrial hall full of machinery: a sharp crack, a massive boom, heavy metal tearing loose and hundreds of machines collapsing, a long echoing rumble. About five seconds.
cascadeBlast.describe: a huge demolition blast in a hall of machinery, metal tearing, a hall of centrifuges going up

takes.label: explosion
takes.note: The second of the two that were let in, and now the only one. The first (realism 4 that night) was listened to again by the lead, blind, five times: once it was 'a series of loud, unsuppressed gunshots followed by a rapid barrage of automatic gunfire', four times the listener gave no answer at all. This one was an explosion three times of three.

old.heard: I heard a series of synthetic bleeps and bloops that sound like a retro video game.
old.label: synthetic beep or video game bleep
faults: Tonal descending pitch sounds like a retro laser
Complete lack of low-frequency explosion rumble
No metallic tearing or debris impact sounds
fixes: Replace the tonal oscillators with broadband noise bursts
Add a low-pass filtered noise layer (below 150 Hz) with a 2-second decay for the blast
Add a metallic layer using comb-filtered noise or FM synthesis with irregular amplitude modulation

cascadeSpin.prompt: Sound effect only: no speech, no voice, no music. Inside a hall of hundreds of spinning gas centrifuges: a steady, intense high-pitched mechanical whir, continuous and unbroken, no beginning and no end. About four seconds.
cascadeSpin.describe: a hall of hundreds of spinning gas centrifuges, a steady intense mechanical whir

whiz.prompt: Sound effect only: no speech, no voice, no music. No gunshot, no bang, no explosion, no impact, no click. Only the sound of one bullet flying past very close to the microphone at high speed: a very fast 'fffzzzip' of air, a thin whine that falls in pitch as it goes by from one side to the other, like a whip of air or a large insect passing at speed. Nothing before it and nothing after. About half a second.
whiz.describe: a single bullet passing very close by the listener's head

chosen.note: Two batches of three, the second with this prompt. Heard blind as a gunshot (four times), a click and a noise burst — never as a round going past, which the listener has a word for. It was in the pack for an hour, let in under a gate widened to gunshots; the three files, listened to again, were heard as a footstep, a gunshot and a click. Taken out: nothing is heard for a round that misses.

rotorBreak.prompt: Sound effect only: no speech, no voice, no music. Heavy steel machine rotors and casings torn loose from their mountings, crashing down and clattering across a concrete floor: metal shrieking, cracking, heavy pieces falling and rolling to a stop. About three seconds.
rotorBreak.describe: machine rotors and steel casings tearing loose and clattering to the floor

shot.prompt: Sound effect only: no speech, no voice, no music. A suppressed military carbine fires a single round, heard close up: a muffled crack, then the bolt cycling and a metallic mechanical clack immediately after. One shot only. About one second.
shot.describe: the player's suppressed carbine firing one round, a muffled crack and the action cycling

chosen.note: All three heard blind as a gunshot, at 4, 6 and 6 for realism. The carbine the game has (pack A's, of 17 November) was heard as a gunshot at 6: no better by the only ear there is, and it is the sound fired ten times a second — not swapped.

pistolShot.prompt: Sound effect only: no speech, no voice, no music. A suppressed semi-automatic pistol fires a single round, heard close up: a soft muffled cough and a quick metallic slide action right after. One shot only. About half a second.
pistolShot.describe: the player's suppressed pistol firing one round

old.heard: A single loud crack of an unsuppressed gunshot.
old.label: gunshot, unsuppressed

chosen.note: One generation of three passed (the others: gun handling; a gunshot with too little between 150 and 4000 Hz); takes 1 and 2 are that one at 4% faster and slower. Judged against the pistol the game has now.

shotgunShot.prompt: Sound effect only: no speech, no voice, no music. A 12-gauge pump shotgun fires a single unsuppressed round indoors: a very loud, sharp crack, a heavy boom, and a short hard echo off concrete walls. One shot only. About one second.
shotgunShot.describe: the player's 12-gauge shotgun firing one round indoors, loud

old.heard: A bullet ricocheting off a metal surface.
old.label: bullet impact or ricochet on metal
faults: Lacks mechanical firing pin and barrel resonance
Low-end is too boomy and explosion-like
Reverb tail is too smooth and noise-like

chosen.note: Heard as a gunshot, not as a shotgun in particular. Judged against the shotgun the game has now (pack A's), which was heard as a ricochet.
